_doc: Domain reference, not auditor code: what each engine feature reads, written from engine\sql\features.sql, features_episode.sql and pass2.sql. Passed to auditor\run_audit.py with --lineage for the gate-consistency check. reads = tx columns read directly; time_cycles = calendar cycles of ts the feature depends on; row_order / adjacency = whether its VALUE depends on tx_key order or on neighbouring rows; from_scores = computed from other accounts' scores (indirect reliance). Update this file whenever a feature's SQL changes.

days_active.how: distinct calendar dates, not hour of day or day of week

flagged_out_share.how: one combined edge flag: headless AND foreign IP AND cash-out narration category

flagged_in_share.how: one combined edge flag: headless AND foreign IP AND cash-out narration category

device_consistency.how: 1 when the account sends from exactly one distinct device value and never from a foreign or reserved IP; no per-device share is used

timing_regularity.how: gaps between outflows ordered by time; tx_key only breaks ties and does not change any gap
